answer: To resist sybil attacks, every new agent first deposits a modest copper bond that stays locked for several epochs before it may vote or collect rewards. If later audits show duplicated identities, the bond is slashed and a public relic of that slash is attached to the fingerprint, so peers automatically refuse lookalikes. A rotating violet puzzle, unique each epoch, must be signed with the same locked key; agents that cannot answer it lose the deposit and cannot cheaply multiply.
